messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx/timeouts for inference-gateway in prod-us-east. p95 ↑ from 130ms to 2.5s, p99 ↑ from 420ms to 7.1s. Error rate = 8% of requests. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/ops/alerts/2367894321 :rotating_light:
Maya (oncall): seeing it. paging eng-runtime and infra. assigning page to Kevin + Junaid.
Kevin: on it. Canary deploy finished ~15m ago? I can check deploy logs.
Junaid: I see a surge of upstream 504s from proxy layer, lots of connection resets to backend inference pods. KV cache hit rate dropped ~60% -> lots of cold microbatches.
Maya (oncall): is traffic global or region-limited?
Sophia: metrics show the spike mostly us-east and us-west, eu stable. Could be routing change.
Kevin: checking rollout history: deploy-bot: "deploy finished" for inference-gateway:v3.7.9 at 2367894200.
deploy-bot: Deploy inference-gateway:v3.7.9 -> prod complete (canary 100%).
Junaid: correlate logs: gateway started returning 502/504 after new sidecar (conn-mgr) update. Stack traces show downstream socket timeout waiting for model-worker response.
Maya (oncall): impact: CS reports 6 customers on live alerts, console shows error surge for many small sessions. Severity S2 given customer impact and degrading SLOs.
CS-Leah: confirming multiple enterprise customers saw failures around 12:03. We should call affected accounts once we stabilize.
Kevin: short-term mitigation options: rollback gateway to v3.7.8; scale up workers; enable fallback routing to dedicated pool; increase proxy timeouts. Rollback fastest.
Sophia: scaling workers will take ~5-7m to warm and may not fix cold-KV behavior. I agree rollback is fastest.
Maya (oncall): do rollback. Junaid please prepare rollback command and monitor health.
Junaid: running dry-run, then rollback. Command: ```
# rollback to previous replicaset
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/inference-gateway --to-revision=44
# or via platform
redwoodctl svc rollback --name inference-gateway --to-tag v3.7.8
```
Kevin: will hold traffic if needed. Starting rollback now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: inference-gateway -> v3.7.8 by Junaid (2367894350)
Maya (oncall): marking incident in tracker and adding timeline.
Junaid: rollback progressing, old pods terminating, new pods starting. watching readiness.
Sophia: adding quick firewall rule to pin customers to fallback region (manual routing) for critical accounts: applied 12:08.
Junaid: rollback finished. deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 2367894410.
deploy-bot: Canary health checks passing.
Kevin: initial metrics: p95 dropped to 200ms, p99 to 450ms within 60s. Error rate down to 0.8%.
Maya (oncall): verifying downstream: model-worker latencies normal, KV hit rate rising back to baseline.
CS-Leah: notifying impacted customers that we mitigated and we'll follow up with details + ETA for postmortem.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Ops-rotations for extended monitoring and root cause. Next oncall: Ops-rotations, please own the full postmortem and RCA.
Ops-rotations: taking ownership. Will run retention capture (logs + pcap from gateway) and set a postmortem meeting.
Kevin: initial hypothesis: conn-mgr sidecar change increased keepalive and connection churn -> backend saw bursts of cold-KV fetches -> microbatching mismatch -> head-of-line blocking at proxy -> p99 spike. Need to check config delta between v3.7.8 and v3.7.9.
Junaid: saving artifacts: traces, flamegraphs, and sample logs to s3://incidents/2367894321/ for the postmortem.
Sophia: schedule: postmortem doc owner Ops-rotations, draft by EOD, meeting tomorrow 09:30 PT. 
Maya (oncall): action items: 1) Ops-rotations to own RCA and remediation plan; 2) Engineering to produce patch reverting conn-mgr changes with test harness; 3) CS to notify customers with timeline; 4) Add canary guardrails to block canary->100% if p95>500ms within 10m.
Kevin: adding a temporary pre-deploy check to CI to run perf smoke on staging cluster.
CS-Leah: compiling list of impacted customers and starting outreach.
Maya (oncall): closing page: keep monitoring for 30m, if metrics stable we'll mark incident mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident 2367894321 status -> MITIGATED (rollback) at 2367894460.
Kevin: metrics stable at 12:16. p95/p99 back within SLAs.
Ops-rotations: taking handoff notes and moving thread to postmortem doc. Assigned owners: Kevin (fix), Junaid (logs & traces), Sophia (canary policy), CS-Leah (customer comms).
Maya (oncall): thanks everyone. Follow-up: full write-up in docs and link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
